Kitchen hob service & repair in Chennai

A built in gas hob gets used every day, so small problems show up quickly: a yellow flame, an igniter that keeps clicking or a stiff knob. We install hobs, service burners, sort out ignition problems and handle repairs.

What we help with

Installation

Hob installation

We fit the new hob into the countertop opening, connect it and check every burner before handing it over.

Maintenance

Cleaning and maintenance advice

Burner servicing, plus simple everyday cleaning tips that keep flames even and ignition reliable.

Repair

Burner and ignition checks

Yellow or uneven flames, burners that will not stay lit and igniters that spark weakly or not at all.

Repair

Hob repairs

Knobs, valves, ignition parts and glass tops. Tell us the brand and model and we will talk you through the repair.

Common kitchen hob problems and needs

  1. Auto ignition not sparking
  2. Yellow or uneven flame
  3. Burner goes out when the knob is released
  4. Knob stiff or loose
  5. Cracked glass top
  6. A new built in hob to install

Safety first. If you smell gas, turn off the cylinder or gas supply, open the windows, avoid electrical switches and contact a professional. Never try to repair gas connections yourself.

Kitchen Hobs: frequently asked questions

Why is my hob flame yellow?

Usually it is blocked burner ports or a burner cap that is not sitting correctly. If cleaning the caps does not help, have it checked.

Do you install built in hobs?

Yes. Tell us the model and your countertop details, and we will plan the installation with you.

Which hob brands do you service?

We are an authorised Elica service company for built in hobs. For any other brand, send us the brand and model and we will let you know.

Is a gas smell an emergency?

Yes, treat it as one. Turn off the gas supply, open the windows, avoid switches and flames, and contact a professional.

Can a cracked glass top be replaced?

Often, yes, depending on whether parts are available for your model. Send us the brand and model and we will check.
